verdict.rationale: Project-local scope is documented for skills. Teams can check in skills relevant to a working folder, and Codex scans `.agents/skills` from the current directory up to the repo root. A hands-on probe installed a skill into `./.agents/skills`, and repo marketplaces are named as a team-distribution source. User-global scope is only implied: `$skill-installer` targets 'your own local Codex setup' and plugins install from a marketplace into your account. There is no documented scope choice at plugin install time. missing for 10: an explicit project-vs-user scope option for plugin installs, a documented user-global install location and precedence rules, consistent scope behavior across surfaces (docs say marketplace availability varies by surface).
